title: Media Buyer
description:
This position is responsible for buying designated broadcast and streaming for assigned local markets/accounts, inclusive of linear TV, radio, cable, sports packages and sponsorships.

Responsibilities 

  • Meets with media representatives and accesses media databases to research available options for media placement
  • Negotiates best price, estimates ratings and media placement, as specified in approved media plan 
  • Meets all deadlines
  • Evaluates and negotiates sponsorships, bringing forth new ideas
  • Monitors media agreements and contracts with outside media vendors
  • Oversees media schedules and adjusts broadcasting and online schedules due to program changes or campaign performance 
  • Monitors media placement, time discrepancies and reconciles billing, tracking daily
  • Conducts Post Buy Analysis after every campaign
  • Tracks expenditures to ensure compliance with budget 
  • Research and maintain record of trends, and innovations which affect media buying
  • Provides new opportunities and recommendations/POVs 
  • Maintains excellent relationships with media community, account/media teams and clients


Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of related experience in media buying required (Local media markets)
  • Linear television, spot radio, spot cable, streaming audio, podcasts, video, sports and sponsorship experience (QSR a plus)
  • Experience with Media Ocean preferred
  • Very good mathematical ability required
  • Candidate must be organized, detail oriented, must be able to solve problems and can multitask
  • Good communication/presentation skills

title: Communications Director
description:
As a senior regional lead within our McDonald's practice, you are a critical pillar of the "Three-Legged Stool." You serve as the primary strategic counselor and brand protector for the Northwest Owner/Operator Cooperatives.

In this player-coach role, you own the NW account's strategic roadmap and accountability while providing field support to McDonald's Corporate. You lead a dedicated Tactician to ensure local insights and reporting are delivered to clients and corporate partners in real time, enabling data-driven action across the system.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Client Counsel & Accountability

  • Serve as the primary agency face to the NW Owner/Operator Boards — own the relationship, lead boardroom presentations, and secure buy-in for regional PR strategies
  • Full accountability for the regional PR budget; demonstrate clear value and ROI to Owners, ensuring investment drives local Brand Love and business growth
  • Collaborate with agency leads in markets such as DC, Philly, and Chicago to align regional strategies with national goals

2. Corporate System Support: Recon & Liaison

  • Act as eyes and ears for McDonald's Corporate Government Relations and Crisis leads; provide local recon (regulatory trends, local activism, stakeholder sentiment) that informs national strategy
  • Synthesize and deliver critical field data to both clients and corporate partners — the connective tissue between local reality and corporate planning
  • Identify and cultivate relationships with local community leaders and NGOs, managing the brand's license to operate in the NW

3. Crisis & Issues Support (Non-Media Lead)

  • Oversee hyper-local media and social monitoring via the Tactician; report local developments to Corporate so they can lead media response
  • Ensure local Owners are briefed on Corporate-mandated crisis protocols and synchronized with the national response

4. Brand Representation & Public Presence

  • Serve as the visible, polished face of the agency and the brand at client meetings, community events, sports and nonprofit activations, and stakeholder engagements
  • Demonstrate consistent, composed presence in unscripted settings — including field events, media opportunities, and board environments — where real-time judgment and credibility are paramount
  • Represent client and agency interests with accuracy and clarity, particularly in high-visibility or high-stakes situations

5. Team Leadership

  • Direct and develop a regional Tactician responsible for day-to-day execution; accountable for their growth, output quality, and reporting discipline

Travel & Field Presence Requirements

This role requires consistent in-person presence and is not suited to candidates who prefer primarily desk-based work. Travel and field activity are core to the job, not occasional asks.

Regional Travel

Expect an average of 2–3 business days of travel per month in lighter months, increasing to 5+ business days per month during busier periods (roughly every other month). Travel supports in-person client meetings, stakeholder engagement with local community and government partners, sports and nonprofit partnership obligations, and events and activations.

On-Site Activation Presence

As the regional point person, you are the face and name of the brand in the Northwest. You are expected to be on-site at client activations throughout the year. Activation volume is heavier in the summer months but spans the full calendar year.

This includes:

  • Occasional evening and weekend field activity — this is the nature of event and activation work
  • Day trips and local field assignments requiring in-person presence on short notice
  • Multi-day travel for regional activations, partnership events, and board engagements

Candidates must be comfortable with and prepared for this level of field commitment as a standing expectation of the role.

Candidate Profile

  • 12–15+ years PR, public affairs, communications, or marketing communications experience — deep background in QSR, franchise models, or CPG/Grocery is essential; you understand the speed of retail. Agency experience highly preferred.
  • Boardroom presence — a confident, high-EQ counselor who can navigate a room of 20+ successful, independent business owners
  • The Translator — able to take complex corporate policy and turn it into actionable, high-impact intelligence for local business owners
  • Chameleon-like social intelligence — reads a room instinctively and adjusts accordingly; equally effective delivering a boardroom strategy briefing, navigating a tense owner conversation, or working a crowd at a community activation; knows when to push, when to listen, and when to defuse
  • Strategically grounded — brings a clear point of view and long-horizon thinking; moves beyond tactics to advise clients on what matters and why
  • Relentless accountability — takes personal pride in delivering the plan and managing budgets with total transparency
  • Field-ready — genuinely comfortable with regular travel, on-site activation work, and evening or weekend field commitments as a standing part of the role

title: Integrated Planning Coordinator
description:
Position Description

The Integrated Media Coordinator is an entry-level position that facilitates the learning required to become a media planning and management professional. This role is responsible for providing strategic planning support across multiple campaigns and media channels. The Integrated Media Coordinator is the day-to-day steward of the account and is expected to have an understanding of the client’s media plan, tactics, and campaign objectives. The integrated Media Coordinator provides support in all facets of the tactical communications planning process, driven by a strong interest in media, consumer data, and available media research. The person who holds this position is expected to have a passion for learning and creating new and innovative client campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Support media team in the preparation of planning documents, campaign schedules, budgets, and other project management requirements.
  • Maintain and manage media flowcharts/plans
  • Facilitate key meeting setup, scheduling, and conference reports
  • Manage invoicing, campaign billing coordination, key campaign deadlines, and trafficking of creative materials
  • Cultivate relationships with media vendors, internal teams, and outside partners
  • Work closely with account teams to review and analyze campaign results

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a marketing communications-related field
  • Communications skills with experience in delivering customer service satisfaction
  • Detail minded with exceptional organization skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications with very strong PowerPoint & Excel skills
  • Avid media consumer with an interest in the effect of media communication/consumption
  • Comfortable with the use of and ability to learn new platforms and media tactics
  • Excellent communication skills including verbal communications, active listening, and excellent written grammar and spelling. Diligent note-taking capabilities
  • Ability to balance multiple assignments and set priorities
  • Knowledge of media math (CPM, R/F, etc) a plus
  • Knowledge of media research tools a plus

title: Integrated Media Supervisor
description:
The Integrated Media Supervisor position will be responsible for the planning and stewardship of all media strategy, inclusive of traditional and digital, and be client-facing for multiple Davis Elen clients.


Direct Report

The position will be reporting directly to the Media Director, Strategy Planning & Data Analytics. 


Responsibilities 

  • Supports Media Director in the development of media objectives, strategies, tactics and channel selection
  • Develop digital or traditional media/audience outreach strategies for desired client KPIs 
  • Create strong working relationships with clients
  • Helps manage traditional and digital teams for a holistic approach
  • Researches and gathers data to assist in the preparation of media planning
  • Aids in the development of target consumer profiles
  • Evaluates and sets communication goals by channel, and holistically
  • Evaluates wide range of media vehicles to determine plan application
  • Generates and maintains planning documents such as flowcharts, budgets, program POVs and market landscapes
  • Keeps current on media trends
  • Responsible for holding buyers responsible for hitting comm goals and producing the best schedules possible

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) Marketing, Communications, Advertising or related field 
  • Minimum 3 years agency/media planning experience
  • Experience in organizing sports marketing and or consumer engagement programs
  • Strong leadership skills capable of leading and developing strategic direction
  • Strong understanding of media fundamentals
  • Strong affinity for/knowledge of traditional and e-sports
  • Strong knowledge of MS Suite (Word, Excel and Powerpoint) 
  • Strong written and presentation skills 
  • Proficient in Campaign Manager 360
  • Knowledge and experience with Strata/SBMS, Advantage, Centro Basis a plus
  • Proficient in IMS, Simmons, Scarborough, Rentrak, as well as planning tools such as Clear Decisions, Kantar, MediaTools)

title: Influencer Partnerships Manager
description:
We're looking for an experienced Influencer Manager to run the day-to-day execution of influencer programs for two growing accounts: a regional grocery retailer and a national health and wellness tech brand. This is a hands-on contract role. You'll own the daily work, from sourcing creators and managing contracts to refining content and handling routine client communication. The Director, Influencer Partnerships leads strategy.

If you've run influencer campaigns from start to finish, can work with little direction, and are comfortable managing creators and clients at the same time, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign execution: Manage influencer campaigns from start to finish, keeping them on schedule and on budget, and meeting client expectations.
  • Talent sourcing and vetting: Identify and vet creators across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube based on audience fit, engagement, brand safety and cost. Build and maintain a pipeline of creators for both accounts.
  • Contracts and negotiation: Lead creator outreach, pricing and negotiation. Coordinate contracts, usage rights, deliverables and payments.
  • Content refinement and creator management: Write and manage briefs. Manage feedback and revision rounds with creators, and refine content so it's on-brief, on-brand and ready for client approval.
  • Client communication: Serve as the day-to-day contact on execution: timelines, approvals, status updates and routine questions. Work alongside the account team.
  • Paid amplification: Coordinate whitelisting, boosting and dark posting with the paid and social teams.
  • Production and activations: Support influencer shoots and activations, including logistics and occasional travel.
  • Reporting: Track campaign performance, including engagement rate, website traffic (CTR) and reach. Contribute to wrap reports and recommendations.
  • Admin and operations: Manage tracking, budget reconciliation support and platform management in tools like Sprout Influencer, Cohley, Lefty or similar.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in influencer marketing, with at least 2 years managing campaigns from start to finish. Agency experience is strongly preferred.
  • Negotiation and contracts: Proven experience negotiating creator rates and managing contracts, usage rights and payments.
  • Client-facing confidence: Comfortable managing day-to-day client communication and approvals in a fast-moving, high-expectation environment.
  • Paid social knowledge: Working understanding of whitelisting, boosting and dark posting, and how paid media amplifies creator content.
  • Content judgment: A strong eye for what works on each platform, and the ability to give creators clear, constructive feedback.
  • Category experience: Retail, grocery/CPG, QSR, or health and wellness is a plus.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish): A strong plus. Experience with Hispanic/multicultural creators is highly valued.
  • Tools: Experience with influencer platforms (Sprout Influencer, Cohley, Lefty, CreatorIQ or similar) is preferred.
  • Availability: Able to commit up to 20 hours a week for at least 3 months, with flexibility during peak periods like the holidays.

Who You Are

  • Self-directed: You don't need hand-holding. You take ownership of the work and keep it moving.
  • Organized and detail-oriented: You manage several creators, deadlines and approvals at once without missing anything.
  • A strong communicator: Clear, warm and confident with clients, creators and colleagues.
  • Calm under pressure: You stay steady when timelines are tight and clients have high expectations.
  • Plugged into creator culture: You follow the space closely and bring fresh ideas.

title: Social Media Planner
description:
The Social Media Planner bridges creative storytelling and data analytics. You will analyze consumer behavior, map target audiences, allocate media budgets, and leverage self-serve ad platforms to achieve brand or performance objectives. Davis Elen is seeking a skilled social media planner to work alongside a highly skilled social media team to build social media campaigns that capture prospects’ attention and engage existing customers. 


Responsibilities

  • Campaign Strategy: Build comprehensive paid social media plans aligned with client goals, target demographics, and KPIs.
  • Media Execution: Set up, launch, and manage ad campaigns across social networks (e.g., Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, YouTube Shorts).
  • Budget Management: Monitor daily/monthly media spending, manage bids, and ensure strict adherence to allocated budgets.
  • Performance Optimization: Track real-time campaign metrics, conduct A/B testing on ad creatives and audiences, and optimize ongoing campaigns for lower cost-per-acquisition (CPA).
  • Reporting & Analysis: Use tools like Google Analytics and native platform insights to build performance reports and present strategic insights to stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with creative teams to ensure ad copy and visual assets match campaign goals, and work with media buyers or account managers

 

Skills and qualifications

  • Experience: 1-2 years of digital marketing experience, with a proven track record specifically in paid social media planning and buying.
  • Platform Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, and Google Ads for Shorts
  • Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in data analysis, interpreting platform metrics, Excel, and Google Analytics.
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and relationship-building skills to pitch strategies to clients and collaborate internally.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field.
